Your new favourite healthy sweet treat 🥥🍫 Healthy Bounty Stuffed Dates Ingredients * 8 Medjool dates * ½ cup shredded coconut * 2 tsp coconut oil * 2 tsp maple syrup * ½ cup dark chocolate, melted * Extra shredded coconut, for topping Method 1. Slice each date down one side and remove the pit. 2. Mix the shredded coconut, coconut oil and maple syrup until the mixture sticks together. 3. Stuff each date with the coconut filling. 4. Freeze for 10 minutes. 5. Dip each date into the melted dark chocolate until fully coated. 6. Sprinkle with extra shredded coconut before the chocolate sets. 7. Chill until the chocolate has hardened, then enjoy! Link in my bio for my healthy recipes ❤️
